title: Gophish not showing clicked statistics
body:

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
This is expected. It's not always the case that Gophish receives Email Opened events. It's 100% dependent upon the email client, many of which block tracking pixels for privacy reasons (this is a good thing!).

Instead, when Gophish logs a Clicked Link event in the UI, we also backfill an Email Opened event, since we know the email had to have been opened in order for the link to be clicked.

So while there's nothing we can do to fix the issue of you not seeing separate Email Opened events, hopefully this explains the behavior you're seeing.
